title: Private Search Engines Risk Calculator - Assess Your Privacy
metaDescription: Calculate your search privacy risk level. Compare Google, DuckDuckGo, and other search engines to find the best private search option for you.
description: Assess your current search engine's privacy risks and discover how much personal data you might be exposing. Get personalized recommendations for switching to private alternatives like DuckDuckGo or Startpage.

formula: const engineRisk = { google: 85, bing: 75, yahoo: 80, duckduckgo: 10, startpage: 15, brave: 25 }; const baseRisk = engineRisk[inputs.currentEngine] || 50; const searchMultiplier = Math.min(inputs.dailySearches / 20, 2); const loginPenalty = inputs.loggedIn && ['google', 'bing'].includes(inputs.currentEngine) ? 15: 0; const typeMultiplier = { general: 0.8, mixed: 1.0, personal: 1.3, professional: 0.9 }[inputs.searchTypes]; const incognitoBonus = { never: 0, rarely: -5, sometimes: -10, often: -20, always: -30 }[inputs.incognitoUsage]; const adBlockBonus = inputs.adBlocker ? -15: 0; const riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (baseRisk + loginPenalty + incognitoBonus + adBlockBonus) * searchMultiplier * typeMultiplier)); const riskLevel = riskScore >= 70 ? 'High': riskScore >= 40 ? 'Medium': riskScore >= 20 ? 'Low': 'Minimal'; const dataPoints = Math.round(inputs.dailySearches * 365 * (riskScore / 100) * 3); return { riskScore: Math.round(riskScore), riskLevel, dataPoints };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your search privacy risk based on your chosen search engine's data collection practices, search frequency, account usage, and protective measures. Private search engines like DuckDuckGo and Startpage significantly reduce tracking compared to Google or Bing.
tips: Switch to DuckDuckGo or Startpage for anonymous searching without sacrificing quality
Use a privacy-focused browser which defaults to private search engines and blocks trackers
Sign out of Google/Microsoft accounts when searching to reduce profile building
Use private browsing mode for sensitive searches, even with private search engines
Consider different search engines for different purposes - DuckDuckGo for privacy, Google for local businesses

interpretation.label: Minimal Risk
interpretation.description: Excellent privacy practices. You're using private search engines and protective measures effectively.

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good privacy practices with room for minor improvements. Consider switching to private search engines.

interpretation.label: Medium Risk
interpretation.description: Moderate privacy exposure. Switching to DuckDuckGo or Startpage would significantly improve your privacy.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant privacy exposure. Your searches are being tracked and profiled. Consider immediate switch to private alternatives.
